title: dayena
intro: Dayena, commonly known as Lippia alba, is a tropical plant native to the Americas, particularly in the Caribbean and Central America. The health benefits of Dayena include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, protect against cell damage, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Dayena include its ability to treat digestive issues, such as nausea and vomiting, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat colds, fever, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Dayena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
